pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sakkesu viharati Kapilavatthusmiṃ Nigrodhārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhikkhunūpassayaṃ upasaṃkamitvā chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo ovadanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:1.5: hi mayaṃ ayye gaccheyyāma ovādassa kāraṇā, ayyā chabbaggiyā idh' eva amhe ovadantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:1.7: kathañ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhikkhunūpassayaṃ upasaṃkamitvā bhikkhuniyo ovadissantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:1.8: atha kho tā bhikkhuniyo bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:1.10: kathañ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhikkhunūpassayaṃ . . . ovadissantīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:1.14: kathañ hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā . . . ovadissatha,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:1.15: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:1.16: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:1.17.1: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhunūpassayaṃ upasaṃkamitvā bhikkhuniyo ovadeyya, pācittiyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:1.18: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:2.1: tena kho pana samayena Mahāpajāpati Gotamī gilānā hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:2.2: therā bhikkhū yena Mahāpajāpati Gotamī ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:2.4: kacci te Gotami khamanīyaṃ, kacci yāpanīyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:2.5: na me ayyā khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:2.7: na bhagini kappati bhikkhunūpassayaṃ upasaṃkamitvā bhikkhuniyā dhammaṃ desetun ti kukkuccāyantā na desesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:2.8: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena Mahāpajāpati Gotamī ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:2.9: nisajja kho bhagavā Mahāpajāpatiṃ Gotamiṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:2.10: kacci te Gotami khamanīyaṃ kacci yāpanīyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:2.11: pubbe me bhante therā bhikkhū āgantvā dhammaṃ desenti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:2.13: idāni pana bhagavatā paṭikkhittan ti kukkuccāyantā na desenti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:2.15: atha kho bhagavā Mahāpajāpatiṃ Gotamiṃ dhammiyā kathāya . . . sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:2.16: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:2.17: anujānāmi bhikkhave bhikkhunūpassayaṃ upasaṃkamitvā gilānaṃ bhikkhuniṃ ovadituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:2.18: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:2.19.1: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhunūpassayaṃ upasaṃkamitvā bhikkhuniyo ovadeyya aññatra samayā, pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:2.20: tatthāyaṃ samayo: gilānā hoti bhikkhunī, ayaṃ tattha samayo 'ti. ||2||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:3.1.16: na sakkoti ovādāya vā saṃvāsāya vā gantuṃ. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc23:3.2.1: upasampannāya upasampannasaññī bhikkhunūpassayaṃ upasaṃkamitvā aññatra samayā ovadati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
